items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Amasty extensions leading to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: Sansec reported a critical vulnerability in 25 Amasty extensions that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix on May 12, 2026, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization, improper access control, stored XSS, and path traversal, which could lead to full system takeover, data leaks, admin hijacking, and unauthorized file exposure.
